{{Quote|He goes by the name of Nirame Sakute, and he's trying to make a name for himself in Nym's organization.|[[Talon Karrde]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
'''Nirame Sakute''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] as a trainer and often worked with the [[Smugglers' Alliance]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Nirame was working from the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Trade Outpost]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Equipment==
During his time at the Trade Outpost on Dathomir, Sakute [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] a military travel [[Backpack/Legends|pack]], a [[red]] [[Leather/Legends|leather]] trim [[shirt]] with [[black]] [[Color/Legends|colored]] trim, a [[Silver/Legends|silver]] colored [[Padded armor/Legends|padded armor]] belt, a red decorative skirt, and black women's shoes.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You can just call me Sir.|Nirame Sakute, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
Nirame Sakute was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nirame Sakute was added to the game with the release of the space expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

In the game, Nirame Sakute had the appearance of a female Rodian and wore woman clothes. However, all conversation clearly identified him as a male.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
